aboutText: With over 20 years of experience in the timber industry, Real Good Wood has been a cornerstone of the Richmond community, providing premium hardwood and expert craftsmanship. Our sawmilling and custom manufacturing services are renowned for their reliability and precision, ensuring every project is completed to the highest standards. We are committed to sustainable sourcing and transparent practices, making us your trusted partner from forest to home.
servicesText: At Real Good Wood, we provide a full spectrum of timber services designed to cater to builders, carpenters, and homeowners alike. Our expertise in hardwood supply, sawmilling, and custom manufacturing means we can handle projects of any scale, always with a focus on quality and sustainability.

services.name: Hardwood Supply
services.desc: We offer a diverse range of sustainably sourced hardwood, ideal for flooring, furniture, and construction projects across Melbourne.

services.name: Sawmilling
services.desc: Our advanced sawmilling facilities efficiently convert raw logs into precise timber cuts, tailored to your specific requirements.

services.name: Custom Timber Manufacturing
services.desc: From structural beams to intricate joinery, we craft custom timber components with meticulous attention to detail and quality.

services.name: Charcoal Production
services.desc: We produce high-grade charcoal from timber offcuts, suitable for barbecues, artistic use, and various industrial applications.

services.name: Log Trading
services.desc: Engage with our log trading service for buying or selling raw timber logs, supported by our extensive industry network.

services.name: Sustainable Timber Consulting
services.desc: Our experts provide guidance on eco-friendly timber selection, helping you make informed and sustainable choices for projects.

testimonials.name: Tom Henderson
testimonials.text: Real Good Wood supplied the hardwood for our home renovation in Richmond, and the quality was outstanding. The team was professional from start to finish, delivering on time and within budget. We couldn't be happier with the results and will definitely use them again.

testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell
testimonials.text: We used their sawmilling service for a custom furniture project, and the precision was incredible. The timber was perfectly cut, making our job much easier. Highly recommend their expertise for any detailed woodworking needs.

testimonials.name: David Chen
testimonials.text: The charcoal production from Real Good Wood is top-notch. We've been using it for our restaurant's barbecue, and it burns consistently with great flavour. Their sustainable approach and reliable supply make them a preferred choice.

blog.title: Choosing the Right Hardwood for Your Flooring
blog.excerpt: Choosing the right hardwood is crucial for flooring longevity. In this post, we explore top species like Spotted Gum and Blackbutt that handle wear and tear beautifully in Australian conditions.

blog.title: Benefits of Sustainable Timber Sourcing
blog.excerpt: Discover how sustainable timber sourcing supports environmental conservation and local forestry economies. We discuss key certifications and practices for responsible procurement in Victoria.

blog.title: Tips for Maintaining Timber Furniture
blog.excerpt: Simple care routines can keep your timber furniture looking new for years. Learn about cleaning methods, protective finishes, and avoiding common damage in Australian climates.

blog.excerpt: An overview of how logs are transformed into usable timber, covering cutting techniques, drying methods, and quality control for optimal results in manufacturing.
